hypothesis.claim: Same-radio TSF agreement, WPS UUID and MAC-family rules group the owner's BSSIDs into physical units correctly, and unit selection/tests/reports can be added without changing any existing behaviour
hypothesis.disconfirming_result: The owner's router does not form one unit, unrelated OUIs merge, a coincident clock persists as a link, or any existing test/parity row fails

decision.why: Works for any equipment without credentials or measurement-boundary change; owner: 'a unit approximation ... would be a strong MVP'
rejected: D first (disconnects the PC; DR-0004 boundary)

change.summary: TSF/WPS capture; PhysicalUnitGrouper with overrides in Settings; NetworkSelection units + SingleUnit/MultipleUnits; explorer Group by Access point with badges, evidence, mesh hint, context menus; units resolved at test start; SAT-ANALYTICS-3 AnalyzeUnit; report schema v3 (_units.csv, PDF 6b, JSON units); demo data; docs; version 1.4.0; privacy redaction of fixtures (PU-6)

what_worked: Measuring the real environment before designing
Prototype on real data before C#
what_failed: Real BSSIDs copied into fixtures/demo/docs (PU-6, corrected before any sync or push)
Python escape put newlines into a C# literal
residual_risk: Installed-app grouping on the owner's networks unverified (T23-WP6)
Vendors with other MAC schemes may group only per radio

lessons.transferable_rule: Inferred identities carry confidence, evidence and a user override, and are frozen per measurement; never copy real identifiers into code or docs
